_comment: VED Runtime — chamber/node specifications. One file per node. Order is significant: nodes are numbered to reflect the entry sequence defined by the blueprint. The Sequence Chamber is always Node 01 because no diagnosis begins before sequence clarity. Nodes 02–05 are specified; 06–09 are pending. The Runtime Meta-Layer (spatial, navigation, temporal, cartographic, atmospheric, memory) lives separately at _brief/runtime-meta-layer.md.
